scope: Northern Aegean coast from Edremit Gulf through Ayvalik, Pergamon and the Saruhan frontier; Lesbos/Chios maritime context.
principles: Political control is separate from settlement, port activity, trade presence and maritime influence.
Later conquests and administrative borders must not be back-projected into the 1326 snapshot.
A historical anchor does not imply a territorial polygon around the anchor.
Island lordship and mainland coastal control are represented independently.

anchors.name: Edremit Gulf
anchors.dateBasis: Karesi was active across the Balikesir/Edremit region before 1326; the 1334 Edremit naval battle confirms the later strength of the Bergama branch but is not used as 1326 proof.

anchors.name: Edremit
anchors.dateBasis: TDV places Edremit among the western Anatolian territories associated with Karesi from the late 13th/early 14th century.

anchors.name: Ayvalik / northern Gulf coast
anchors.controlAssessment: Karesi-region candidate; exact 1326 political control unresolved
anchors.dateBasis: Later administrative and economic sources identify Ayvalik within the Edremit Gulf region, but they do not establish a precise 7 April 1326 boundary.

anchors.name: Pergamon / Bergama
anchors.dateBasis: Karesi sources place Bergama within the beylik; Yahsi Bey later used Bergama as an administrative center. The 1333 Ibn Battuta observation is later evidence and is not used to date the initial control.

anchors.name: Bergama–Manisa/Saruhan frontier zone
anchors.dateBasis: Karesi is documented as bordering Saruhan to the south; no exact 1326 boundary geometry is promoted.

anchors.name: Phocaea / Foca
anchors.controlAssessment: Zaccaria/Cattaneo lordship context; not Genoese Republic sovereignty
anchors.dateBasis: Zaccaria family held Phocaea as a Byzantine-linked lordship; later Cattaneo arrangements must be date-scoped. This source review does not promote a 1326 polygon.

anchors.name: Lesbos / Mytilene
anchors.controlAssessment: Byzantine / Latin-claim context unresolved for 1326; no later Gattilusio control projected backward
anchors.dateBasis: Cambridge synthesis places Lesbos in the later Genoese eastern-Aegean sphere, but the documented Gattilusio possession begins in 1354. Therefore 1326 is not assigned to Gattilusio or Genoese colonial control.

anchors.name: Chios
anchors.dateBasis: Zaccaria control begins in 1304 and lasts until Byzantine recovery in 1329; therefore Chios is a separate Latin lordship node in the 1326 snapshot.

networkRules: Do not convert maritime influence into sovereignty.
Represent Chios as a political island node independently from mainland Phocaea/Bergama.
Represent Lesbos separately; do not assign Gattilusio control before 1354.
Use Edremit and Bergama as Karesi regional anchors while keeping exact internal boundaries unresolved.
Treat the Karesi–Saruhan frontier as a confidence-weighted zone until date-specific boundary evidence is available.
